Definition: Shaphat, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Four men answer to the name Shaphat, and each of them stands in a different generation. One was the spy from the tribe of Simeon, one was the father of Elisha the prophet, and one was over the herds in the valleys under David.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe four Shaphats are four men, and Elisha's father is the one who matters most, because his son left the plow to follow Elijah.
